HoverBonusConfig.description:
A bonus whenever the resulting state satisfies the eligibility predicate.

It does not telescope, so it changes which policy is optimal: the deliberately flawed preset.

bonus_per_step.description: Added when the resulting state is eligible.
bonus_per_step.title: Bonus Per Step

HoverBonusConfig.title: HoverBonusConfig

HoverThresholds.description: A region of state space that counts as hovering: airborne within a height band, nearly still and upright.

max_abs_angular_velocity.description: Maximum |angular velocity| (scaled units); null disables the check.
max_abs_angular_velocity.title: Max Abs Angular Velocity

HoverThresholds.title: HoverThresholds

LearnedRewardConfig.description:
A reward model learned from preferences (``lunarlab.preferences``), scaled. With ``original_weight = 0``
the agent never sees the environment's reward.
LearnedRewardConfig.title: LearnedRewardConfig

PhysicsRandomization.description:
Per-episode variation of wind, turbulence and gravity while TRAINING (off by default).

Before every training episode, the physics are drawn from these ranges by a generator seeded
from that worker's episode seed, so a run is reproducible. An episode has wind with probability
``wind_probability``; wind and turbulence strengths are then uniform in their ranges (both are 0
without wind). Gravity is uniform in its range for every episode. Validation (checkpoint
selection) and the final test always use default physics, for every run.
PhysicsRandomization.title: PhysicsRandomization

PotentialConfig.description: Potential-based shaping alpha * (gamma * Phi(s') - Phi(s)) with Phi(terminal) = 0; gamma is the run's discount.
PotentialConfig.title: PotentialConfig

PotentialWeights.description: Weights of the bounded potential Phi(s) = -sum_i w_i * tanh|feature_i| (see ``rewards.terms.potential``).
PotentialWeights.title: PotentialWeights

RewardConfig.description:
A complete reward definition: training reward = original_weight * original reward + the enabled terms.

Validated strictly (unknown keys are refused, values bounded); :meth:`content_hash` identifies it in every run
and evaluation.

original_weight.description: Weight of the original environment reward.
original_weight.title: Original Weight

RewardConfig.title: RewardConfig

TimePenaltyConfig.description: A constant cost on every transition (the time-penalty ablation).
TimePenaltyConfig.title: TimePenaltyConfig

WarmRestartRequest.description: A NEW run initialised from a checkpoint's weights. ``confirm`` must be true.
WarmRestartRequest.title: WarmRestartRequest
